producer.responsibility: Единолично вернуть negotiation/base error до ranked bundle без response assembly; после появления ranked bundle открыть durable response lifecycle, одним outbox CAS выбрать normal/error/suppressed terminal и только после exact readback передать immutable delivery и одну release identity; application::public_search производит FinalizedAnchorAssembly/permit либо typed replay/pre-lease terminal

capabilities: select v1 for absent or exact 1
reject any other value before search
durably open and commit one bounded immutable v2 terminal
replay exact terminal delivery from journal
retry one logical generation lease release until authoritative closure

machine_contracts.symbol: ResponseVersionRequest v1, RankedCanonicalResultBundle v1, FinalizedAnchorAssembly v1, PublicResponseAssemblyTerminal v1, GenerationPublicationLeaseReleaseRequest/Outcome v1, PublicSearchResponse v2

inputs.meaning: Сырое необязательное поле response_version до выбора v1/v2 и до запуска поиска
inputs.identity: absent or exact raw version string

inputs.meaning: Внутренний упорядоченный bundle одной response assembly и одного поколения; каждая позиция сохраняет opaque position_id, record_id, state_generation и все display fields до wire-проекции
inputs.identity: workspace identity + response_assembly_id + query + captured state_generation + ordered opaque position_id + record_id pairs
inputs.cardinality: 0..1 bundle; exactly 1 only after successful base search
constraints: position_id is unique within assembly
position_id is not rank and is removed only by outer wire projection

inputs.meaning: Единый success handoff с assembly identity, ordered position-to-outcome mapping и live publication permit
inputs.identity: workspace identity + permit_id + response_assembly_id + captured state_generation + lease_id + ordered position_id + record_id + SearchSourceAnchorOutcome entries
inputs.cardinality: exactly 1 for ACTIVE_ACQUIRED complete anchor assembly, including empty results; otherwise 0
constraints: assembly/generation/positions exactly equal IN-RANKED-CANONICAL-BUNDLE
permit is OPEN and consumable once
position_id remains until outer projection

inputs.meaning: Отдельный authoritative consume-once permit для exact FinalizedAnchorAssembly
inputs.identity: workspace identity + permit_id + response_assembly_id + captured state_generation + lease_id + finalized outcome count
inputs.cardinality: exactly 1 for ACTIVE_ACQUIRED FinalizedAnchorAssembly; otherwise 0
constraints: permit_id and all correlation fields exactly equal FinalizedAnchorAssembly
only first terminal CAS may consume OPEN
replay returns the committed terminal and never creates another envelope

inputs.meaning: Авторитетная capability готовности выпущенной схемы и producer Public Search v2
inputs.identity: released producer build + schema digest + V1_ONLY|V1_V2_READY
inputs.cardinality: exactly 1 per request
constraints: explicit v2 starts only for V1_V2_READY
V1_ONLY leaves default and explicit v1 operational
readiness is not inferred from requested version

inputs.meaning: Типизированный отказ базового поиска до появления ranked bundle
inputs.identity: public error code + permit_scope(NONE|permit_id) + response_assembly_scope(NONE|response_assembly_id) + lease_scope(NONE|lease_id)
inputs.cardinality: 0..1; exactly 1 only when base search fails
constraints: code is INVALID_REQUEST|NOT_READY|STALE_INDEX|BUSY|TIMEOUT|RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE|SEARCH_FAILED
permit_scope, response_assembly_scope and lease_scope are NONE before ranked bundle

inputs.meaning: Внутренний STALE_INDEX после ranked bundle, если application::public_search не может завершить все outcomes в захваченном поколении
inputs.identity: workspace identity + response_assembly_id + STALE_INDEX + captured state_generation + observed state_generation
inputs.cardinality: 0..1; exactly 1 only when generation changes during anchor outcome assembly

inputs.meaning: Типизированный post-bundle pre-lease отказ generation correlation mismatch либо generation coordinator FAILED без созданного lease
inputs.identity: workspace identity + response_assembly_id + SEARCH_FAILED + captured state_generation + exact stage + cause
inputs.cardinality: 0..1; exactly 1 for bundle/search generation mismatch before lookup or coordinator FAILED

inputs.meaning: Correlated CANCELLED либо TIMEOUT, для которого application::public_search доказал отсутствие ACQUIRED lease
inputs.identity: workspace identity + response_assembly_id + CANCELLED|TIMEOUT + lifecycle_phase + exact stage + cause
inputs.cardinality: 0..1; exactly 1 only when pre-permit lifecycle wins without ACQUIRED lease
constraints: CANCELLED produces no public envelope
TIMEOUT produces exactly one public TIMEOUT error
no release request is allowed without lease_id

inputs.meaning: Post-permit событие deadline, cancellation, bounded serialization или immutable terminal commit
inputs.identity: workspace identity + permit_id + response_assembly_id + lease_id + CANCELLED|TIMEOUT|RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE|SEARCH_FAILED|COMMIT_FAILED + exact stage + cause
inputs.cardinality: 0..1; exactly 1 when post-permit lifecycle does not commit the normal response
constraints: permit_id, response_assembly_id and lease_id must exactly equal IN-FINALIZED-ANCHOR-ASSEMBLY before terminal CAS
mismatch consumes no permit and creates one internal lifecycle failure
CANCELLED and COMMIT_FAILED suppress public response
TIMEOUT, RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE and SEARCH_FAILED request one safe public error commit
all valid codes consume the same permit terminal state machine

inputs.meaning: Авторитетный readback идемпотентного release request
inputs.identity: workspace identity + response_assembly_id + lease_id + committed_terminal_identity + idempotency_key + terminal_journal_ref + terminal_record_digest + RELEASED|ALREADY_RELEASED|RELEASE_FAILED + state_revision + cause when failed
inputs.cardinality: 0..1 per release attempt/readback; exactly 1 only when the same coordinator decision has neither commit-recovery status nor state-access block
constraints: outcome repeats the complete release request identity including response_assembly_id
RELEASED applies ACTIVE to RELEASED once
ALREADY_RELEASED is success only for exact retained replay identity
RELEASE_FAILED removes no lease and names retry/readback cause
mismatch never releases another lease

exactly one of IN-GENERATION-LEASE-RELEASE-OUTCOME, IN-RELEASE-GENERATION-LEASE-COMMIT-RECOVERY-STATUS or IN-RELEASE-GENERATION-LEASE-STATE-ACCESS-BLOCKED exists for the same release operation decision
authoritative semantics belong to BC-FS-GENERATION-PUBLICATION-LEASE

inputs.meaning: Типизированный результат неизвестного либо неподтверждённого commit release-операции без выдуманного domain outcome
inputs.identity: workspace identity + operation_kind + operation_identity + proposal revision/digest + NOT_COMMITTED_RETRY(previous_revision) | COMMIT_READBACK_REQUIRED(lookup_attempt_identity + stage + cause + attempt_number + deadline) | COMMIT_RECOVERY_BLOCKED(last_lookup_attempt_identity + stage + cause + evidence_ref)
inputs.cardinality: 0..1 per release operation decision; exactly 1 only when the same decision has neither domain release outcome nor state-access block
constraints: operation_kind is RELEASE
complete release identity, proposal revision/digest and variant payload are preserved byte-for-byte from OUT-LEASE-COMMIT-RECOVERY-STATUS
a status for an earlier proposal cannot advance or block a later proposal
never maps to RELEASED or ALREADY_RELEASED
exactly one of this status, IN-GENERATION-LEASE-RELEASE-OUTCOME or IN-RELEASE-GENERATION-LEASE-STATE-ACCESS-BLOCKED exists for the same release operation decision

inputs.meaning: Typed terminal block exact RELEASE, когда authoritative generation ledger потерян, повреждён либо недоступен
inputs.identity: workspace identity + operation_kind + operation_identity + lookup attempt identity + optional retained proposal revision/digest + optional lookup revision + MISSING_PREVIOUS|CORRUPT|UNAVAILABLE(stage + cause)
inputs.cardinality: 0..1 per release decision; exactly 1 only when the same decision has neither domain release outcome nor commit-recovery status
constraints: operation_kind is RELEASE
complete release identity, lookup evidence and optional retained proposal identity are preserved byte-for-byte from OUT-LEASE-STATE-ACCESS-BLOCKED
mutually exclusive with IN-GENERATION-LEASE-RELEASE-OUTCOME and IN-RELEASE-GENERATION-LEASE-COMMIT-RECOVERY-STATUS for the same decision
preserves the already committed public assembly terminal
creates no proposal, CLOSED, release acknowledgement, permit or public envelope
blocks release closure and writer admission

inputs.meaning: Pending pre-permit CANCELLED либо TIMEOUT, уже машинно дополненный exact ACTIVE_ACQUIRED lease_id
inputs.identity: workspace identity + permit_id + response_assembly_id + lease_id + CANCELLED|TIMEOUT + exact stage + cause
inputs.cardinality: 0..1; exactly 1 only when pending termination meets ACTIVE_ACQUIRED
constraints: same FinalizedAnchorAssembly exists
must enter post-permit terminal CAS
cannot enter a pre-permit branch

inputs.meaning: Durably committed tagged PROCESS_DIED cleanup для exact response assembly и lease
inputs.identity: workspace identity + cleanup_event_id + command_id + command_ordinal + command_count + response_assembly_id + lease_id + owner_process_identity + cleanup_revision
inputs.cardinality: 0..N per cleanup event; exactly 1 stable command for each removed lease and 0 when no lease was removed
constraints: command is forwarded unchanged only from durable DeadProcessLeaseCleanupOutcome
all commands for one cleanup_event_id have the same command_count and contiguous ordinal
replay preserves workspace identity, command_id and complete identity
each command is consumed at most once by one matching response lifecycle in the exact workspace
PROCESS_DIED is not RELEASED or ALREADY_RELEASED
exact workspace, assembly and lease are required and workspace selects the authoritative outbox
matching ABSENT creates only PREOPEN_PROCESS_DIED_CLOSED tombstone; matching OPEN or TERMINAL_COMMITTED with RELEASE_PENDING|RECOVERY_REQUIRED|RECOVERY_BLOCKED may close as PROCESS_DIED_CLOSED
TERMINAL_COMMITTED CLOSED|PROCESS_DIED_CLOSED or any mismatched command produces no lifecycle transition

inputs.meaning: Авторитетный durable lookup response lifecycle: ABSENT, OPEN, TERMINAL_COMMITTED, PREOPEN_PROCESS_DIED_CLOSED, CORRUPT либо UNAVAILABLE
inputs.identity: workspace + response_assembly_id + lookup_attempt_identity + optional outbox_revision + ABSENT | OPEN(permit_id + lease_id + captured generation + terminal_identity_seed + optional recovery token) | TERMINAL_COMMITTED(terminal, immutable delivery or suppression, release identity, closure NONE|RELEASE_PENDING|RECOVERY_REQUIRED|RECOVERY_BLOCKED|CLOSED|PROCESS_DIED_CLOSED + exact last_committed_closure_transition(proposal revision/digest + embedded full response_entry_mode_evidence) iff release-response-derived closure was persisted + exact typed blocked_evidence iff RECOVERY_BLOCKED + exact workspace-scoped consumed process_death_command_identity iff PROCESS_DIED_CLOSED) | PREOPEN_PROCESS_DIED_CLOSED(exact workspace-scoped consumed process_death_command_identity + receipt revision/digest, no terminal) | CORRUPT(stage + cause) | UNAVAILABLE(stage + cause)
inputs.cardinality: exactly 1 per outbox operation or replay readback
constraints: states are a closed mutually exclusive union

CORRUPT and UNAVAILABLE have priority over every pre-lease, replay, arbitration and commit-confirm transform and are consumed only by TR-REJECT-CORRUPT-RESPONSE-OUTBOX or TR-REJECT-UNAVAILABLE-RESPONSE-OUTBOX
OPEN lookup returns the exact durable terminal_identity_seed written by the open proposal

TERMINAL_COMMITTED with release-response-derived CLOSED|RECOVERY_REQUIRED|RECOVERY_BLOCKED returns byte-for-byte the last committed closure proposal revision/digest and its covered response_entry_mode_evidence; the evidence is the embedded complete closed ResponseLifecycleEntryMode value containing workspace, assembly, variant, process epoch, lifecycle attempt and proposal/commit or terminal/restart-intent identity, never an opaque pointer
RELEASE_PENDING has no committed closure transition or mode evidence
TERMINAL_COMMITTED RECOVERY_BLOCKED returns byte-for-byte the stored block scope, operation identity, proposal revision/digest, lookup attempt/deadline, stage, cause and evidence

TERMINAL_COMMITTED PROCESS_DIED_CLOSED returns byte-for-byte cleanup_event_id, command_id, ordinal/count, owner, assembly, lease and cleanup_revision of the consumed command and has no response_entry_mode_evidence
PREOPEN_PROCESS_DIED_CLOSED is a durable tombstone created only from authoritative ABSENT plus exact process-death command; it contains no permit, terminal, envelope or release
journal is durable local state owned only by thin_search lifecycle
terminal and embedded mode evidence retention is not shorter than delivery, release, closure, command and acquire replay horizons
CORRUPT and UNAVAILABLE never permit reconstruction from current generation
UNAVAILABLE never fabricates outbox_revision or ABSENT

inputs.meaning: Закрытый durable readback proposed outbox transition
inputs.identity: proposal identity + COMMITTED_EXACT(outbox_revision + record_digest) | NOT_COMMITTED(previous_revision) | UNKNOWN(stage + cause)
inputs.cardinality: 0..1 per proposed transition; exactly 1 for every write attempt
constraints: only COMMITTED_EXACT exposes terminal, delivery, release, recovery token or durable RECOVERY_BLOCKED evidence
COMMITTED_EXACT preserves the complete proposal identity including typed blocked_evidence byte-for-byte
NOT_COMMITTED and UNKNOWN require lookup/replay
neither authorizes a new identity

inputs.meaning: Exact acquire replay после terminal release с authoritative terminal journal ref/digest и без permit
inputs.identity: workspace identity + response_assembly_id + lease_id + committed_terminal_identity + terminal_journal_ref + terminal_record_digest + released_revision
inputs.cardinality: 0..1; exactly 1 for REPLAYED_TERMINAL
constraints: the replay input itself creates no permit, envelope or new release identity
only exact journal readback may redeliver prior bytes
released_revision may authorize only a downstream same-key continuation of the original release when authoritative response outbox closure is still RELEASE_PENDING|RECOVERY_REQUIRED

inputs.meaning: Recovery-only acquire replay после PROCESS_DIED без permit и public envelope
inputs.identity: workspace identity + response_assembly_id + lease_id + owner_process_identity + cleanup_revision + PROCESS_DIED
inputs.cardinality: 0..1; exactly 1 for REPLAYED_PROCESS_DIED
constraints: no new terminal, envelope or release is created
caller receives typed replay-unavailable control outcome

inputs.meaning: Наблюдаемый acquire recovery либо state-access block той же response assembly без permit или public terminal
inputs.identity: workspace identity + response_assembly_id + captured_generation + owner_process_identity + acquire operation identity + optional proposal revision/digest + RETRY_REQUIRED|READBACK_REQUIRED|RECOVERY_BLOCKED + optional lookup attempt/deadline + exact evidence
inputs.cardinality: 0..1 current recovery/access state per response assembly
constraints: never carries permit, finalized assembly, public terminal or release
only RECOVERY_BLOCKED may create GENERATION_ACQUIRE_STATE PublicSearchRecoveryBlocked

inputs.meaning: Авторитетная команда bounded retry либо исчерпания восстановления response outbox
inputs.identity: workspace identity + response_assembly_id + lookup_attempt_identity + recovery_status_code + attempt_identity + attempt_number + deadline + RETRY|EXHAUSTED
inputs.units: unsigned attempt number and monotonic deadline
inputs.cardinality: 0..N retries followed by exactly 1 EXHAUSTED only when the bounded policy is spent
constraints: same response_assembly_id and lookup_attempt_identity are retained
RETRY cannot invent outbox revision or terminal
EXHAUSTED is the only transition to operation-level BLOCKED

outputs.meaning: Авторитетный взаимоисключающий режим входа в response lifecycle, отделяющий подтверждение текущего commit от restart-readback
outputs.identity: workspace identity + response_assembly_id + process_epoch_identity + lifecycle_entry_attempt_identity + INITIAL_COMMIT_CONFIRMATION(proposal identity + commit_attempt_identity) | RESTART_READBACK(authoritative terminal revision + terminal_record_digest + deterministic restart_readback_identity + restart_intent_ref)
outputs.cardinality: exactly 1 closed-union variant per live lifecycle-entry selection for current-epoch terminal confirmation or existing-terminal carrier reconstruction; exactly 0 for persisted-closure readback and command-only process-death replay; the two produced variants are mutually exclusive for one lifecycle_entry_attempt_identity
outputs.creation_condition: Thin_search dispatcher receives either matching current-epoch proposal plus commit readback, or retained TERMINAL_COMMITTED lookup plus exactly one replay/resume intent including a redelivered release coordinator response; TR-READBACK-PERSISTED-RESPONSE-CLOSURE consumes embedded evidence without selecting or producing a live mode
constraints: INITIAL_COMMIT_CONFIRMATION is selected only in the process epoch that owns the matching proposed transition and commit readback

RESTART_READBACK is derived without a separate write as sha256(domain + workspace + response_assembly_id + authoritative terminal revision + terminal_record_digest); restart_intent_ref copies exactly one triggering replay/resume identity or coordinator response identity; retained terminal row is the durable authority
terminal retention is not shorter than delivery, release and closure replay horizons
crash after terminal commit but before dispatch or before consuming a coordinator response cannot erase restart evidence
one authoritative TERMINAL_COMMITTED lookup cannot be consumed under both variants in the same lifecycle entry attempt
persisted closure confirmation validates embedded response_entry_mode_evidence as data and emits no OUT-RESPONSE-LIFECYCLE-ENTRY-MODE
mode is control evidence and never changes the stable release request identity

outputs.meaning: Версионированный базовый ответ с exactly-one anchor outcome для каждой внутренне коррелированной позиции
outputs.identity: contract_id + contract_version + query + ordered results including anchor outcome
outputs.cardinality: 0..1 response with 0..6 results
outputs.creation_condition: Raw version is exact 2; ranked bundle exists; publication permit is live; every position has one finalized outcome with matching assembly/record_id/generation; bounded immutable envelope commit succeeds under lease
constraints: contract_id is fastsearch.public-search and contract_version is 2
all v1 display fields and order are retained
path and rank never correlate identity
anchor_outcome is exactly oneOf READY(anchor) or BLOCKED(error)
both, neither, extra fields and mixed generation are rejected

outputs.meaning: Единая ошибка exact-v2 без частичного списка для семи закрытых классов base/pre/post-permit failure
outputs.identity: contract_id fastsearch.public-search-error + contract_version 2 + code + recovery_owner + recovery_action
outputs.creation_condition: Raw version is exact 2, capability is V1_V2_READY and branch is base failure, anchor abort/failure, pre-permit TIMEOUT or exact-correlated post-permit TIMEOUT|RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE|SEARCH_FAILED; CANCELLED and COMMIT_FAILED are forbidden
constraints: closed object has exactly contract_id, contract_version, code, recovery_owner and recovery_action
code is INVALID_REQUEST|NOT_READY|STALE_INDEX|BUSY|TIMEOUT|RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE|SEARCH_FAILED

mapping is INVALID_REQUEST -> CALLER/CORRECT_REQUEST, NOT_READY -> FASTSEARCH_READINESS/RESTORE_READINESS, STALE_INDEX -> FASTSEARCH_SOURCE_STATE/REBUILD_SOURCE_STATE, BUSY -> CALLER/RETRY_SEARCH, TIMEOUT -> CALLER/RETRY_SEARCH, RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE -> CALLER/REFINE_REQUEST, SEARCH_FAILED -> FASTSEARCH_SOURCE_STATE/INSPECT_DIAGNOSTICS
results, anchor_outcome and internal permit/assembly/lease fields are forbidden
CANCELLED and COMMIT_FAILED produce no public envelope
post-permit error emission requires exact internal permit_id, response_assembly_id and lease_id correlation

outputs.meaning: Version-neutral отказ неподдерживаемой версии либо explicit v2 до готовности producer/schema
outputs.identity: UNSUPPORTED_RESPONSE_VERSION(requested value) | PUBLIC_SEARCH_V2_NOT_READY(capability identity)
outputs.creation_condition: Raw version is unsupported or exact 2 while readiness is V1_ONLY; no v2 search input is opened
constraints: default and explicit v1 remain available for V1_ONLY
NOT_READY does not masquerade as v1 success

outputs.meaning: Immutable consume-once terminal notification после первого durable commit; текущее изменяемое состояние generation lease closure читается отдельно из authoritative TERMINAL_COMMITTED row и GenerationLeaseClosureOutcome
outputs.identity: workspace identity + permit_scope(NONE|permit_id) + response_assembly_id + lease_scope(NONE|lease_id) + committed_terminal_identity + idempotency_key + terminal_journal_ref + terminal_record_digest + initial_entry_mode_ref(process_epoch_identity, lifecycle_entry_attempt_identity, commit_attempt_identity) + COMMITTED_RESPONSE|COMMITTED_ERROR|COMMITTED_SUPPRESSED + initial_closure_state NONE|RELEASE_PENDING|PROCESS_DIED_CLOSED + exact workspace-scoped consumed process_death_command_identity iff PROCESS_DIED_CLOSED
outputs.cardinality: 0..1 immutable initial notification per post-bundle response assembly; exactly 1 after first COMMITTED_EXACT terminal write/readback; exact TERMINAL_COMMITTED replay uses ReplayedPublicTerminalDelivery and ReplayedGenerationLeaseContinuation instead of another initial notification; exactly 0 before terminal while response-outbox or generation-acquire recovery is RETRY_REQUIRED|BLOCKED
outputs.creation_condition: Outbox CAS завершил assembly и COMMITTED_EXACT readback подтвердил immutable journal record; повтор читает тот же authoritative terminal, но не переиздаёт initial notification
constraints: terminal variants are mutually exclusive
initial_entry_mode_ref is copied from the single matching INITIAL_COMMIT_CONFIRMATION and allows no RESTART_READBACK carrier
this notification exposes only initial_closure_state and never models later CLOSED|RECOVERY_REQUIRED|RECOVERY_BLOCKED evolution
authoritative current closure is the closed TERMINAL_COMMITTED row plus OUT-GENERATION-LEASE-CLOSURE-OUTCOME or replay continuation
permit_scope, lease_scope, idempotency_key and release fields are NONE for all pre-lease branches
ordinary post-permit terminal contains exact permit_id, lease_id, stable release identity and initial_closure_state RELEASE_PENDING
process-death terminal contains the same complete stable identity, initial_closure_state PROCESS_DIED_CLOSED and workspace-scoped consumed process-death command identity
only first outbox CAS consumes OPEN permit
COMMITTED_RESPONSE has exactly one immutable response
COMMITTED_ERROR has exactly one immutable safe error
COMMITTED_SUPPRESSED has no public envelope
terminal journal retention is not shorter than acquire replay horizon

outputs.meaning: Идемпотентный логический запрос освободить точный source/state generation lease после consume-once terminal
outputs.identity: workspace identity + response_assembly_id + lease_id + committed_terminal_identity + idempotency_key + terminal_journal_ref + terminal_record_digest
outputs.cardinality: exactly 1 logical request per terminal with lease_scope; exact retransmissions allowed until authoritative closure; 0 for lease_scope NONE
outputs.creation_condition: Consume-once leased terminal has COMMITTED_EXACT journal readback and can no longer observe mutable source/state
constraints: request is after durable terminal commit/readback
all fields are copied from terminal and never generated by release transform
retries preserve the complete identity and idempotency key
request alone does not prove release
pre-lease terminal never creates release

outputs.meaning: Наблюдаемый thin_search результат закрытия lease либо состояние обязательного восстановления
outputs.identity: workspace identity + response_assembly_id + lease_id + committed_terminal_identity + idempotency_key + terminal_journal_ref + terminal_record_digest + CLOSED|PROCESS_DIED_CLOSED|RECOVERY_REQUIRED|RECOVERY_BLOCKED + exact typed blocked_evidence iff RECOVERY_BLOCKED + exact consumed process_death_command_identity iff PROCESS_DIED_CLOSED
outputs.cardinality: one current outcome per logical release identity; RECOVERY_REQUIRED may evolve to CLOSED or PROCESS_DIED_CLOSED; RECOVERY_BLOCKED may evolve only by an independent matching PROCESS_DIED cleanup
outputs.creation_condition: Authoritative coordinator returned RELEASED, ALREADY_RELEASED or RELEASE_FAILED; generic release commit status reported NOT_COMMITTED_RETRY, COMMIT_READBACK_REQUIRED or COMMIT_RECOVERY_BLOCKED; typed release GenerationLeaseStateAccessBlocked was persisted as RECOVERY_BLOCKED by exact outbox COMMITTED_EXACT readback; or matching durable PROCESS_DIED cleanup was consumed
constraints: complete release identity including response_assembly_id is preserved
RELEASED and exact ALREADY_RELEASED map to CLOSED
matching tagged owner cleanup maps to PROCESS_DIED_CLOSED and preserves the consumed command identity without pretending release ACK
RELEASE_FAILED, NOT_COMMITTED_RETRY and COMMIT_READBACK_REQUIRED map to retryable RECOVERY_REQUIRED and preserve exact same-key retry/readback evidence
COMMIT_RECOVERY_BLOCKED or typed release GenerationLeaseStateAccessBlocked maps only to terminal RECOVERY_BLOCKED after exact outbox COMMITTED_EXACT readback and never creates another release request
RECOVERY_BLOCKED carries byte-for-byte the originating block scope, operation identity, proposal revision/digest, lookup attempt/deadline, stage, cause and evidence
CLOSED is created only from authoritative RELEASED or exact ALREADY_RELEASED domain outcome
after request deadline runtime supervisor owns bounded RECOVERY_REQUIRED retry/readback; RECOVERY_BLOCKED is an operation-level stop
writer remains blocked while coordinator retains any active lease
immutable public delivery does not wait for closure

outputs.meaning: Durable acknowledgement потребления exact process-death closure command без повторного lifecycle transition
outputs.identity: workspace identity + cleanup_event_id + command_id + command_ordinal + command_count + owner_process_identity + response_assembly_id + lease_id + cleanup_revision + APPLIED|ALREADY_APPLIED|REJECTED_MISMATCH + exact committed outbox revision/digest when applied
outputs.cardinality: exactly 1 per received process-death command after authoritative lookup proves either a committed OPEN|TERMINAL_COMMITTED|PREOPEN_PROCESS_DIED_CLOSED transition, a committed ABSENT tombstone proposal, an exact already-applied replay or REJECTED_MISMATCH; including stale command against TERMINAL_COMMITTED(CLOSED); exact replay returns the same logical acknowledgement
outputs.creation_condition: Matching process-death terminal, closure or pre-open tombstone proposal reached COMMITTED_EXACT; exact TERMINAL_COMMITTED(PROCESS_DIED_CLOSED) or PREOPEN_PROCESS_DIED_CLOSED replay matched the stored consumed command identity; or authoritative OPEN|TERMINAL_COMMITTED|PREOPEN_PROCESS_DIED_CLOSED proved a workspace, command or lifecycle mismatch, including stale command after CLOSED
constraints: APPLIED is emitted only after the exact workspace-scoped command identity is durably stored with PROCESS_DIED_CLOSED or PREOPEN_PROCESS_DIED_CLOSED
ALREADY_APPLIED is byte-identical in workspace, command identity and committed receipt to the earlier APPLIED
REJECTED_MISMATCH names expected and actual workspace/command/assembly/lease/lifecycle identity, is never APPLIED, changes no lifecycle state and never completes supervisor delivery progress
CORRUPT|UNAVAILABLE and UNKNOWN commit produce only typed outbox recovery, never an acknowledgement
one command acknowledgement never acknowledges a sibling ordinal

outputs.meaning: Внутренний отказ применить post-permit termination к несовпадающей assembly или lease без потребления любого permit
outputs.identity: termination identity + expected permit_id + expected response_assembly_id + expected lease_id + observed mismatch
outputs.cardinality: exactly 1 per mismatched post-permit termination attempt
outputs.creation_condition: Termination assembly or lease differs from FinalizedAnchorAssembly before terminal CAS
constraints: no permit is consumed
no public envelope is created
no release request is created
separate recovery token retains the exact permit and conflicting event
correctly correlated lifecycle event must be replayed or recovered within a bounded deadline

outputs.meaning: Exact-correlated termination, восстановленный после mismatch для обязательного завершения live permit
outputs.identity: expected permit_id + expected response_assembly_id + expected lease_id + replayed valid code or synthesized COMMIT_FAILED + recovery cause
outputs.cardinality: exactly 1 per unresolved correlation failure after bounded recovery decision
outputs.creation_condition: Runtime supervisor invokes the thin_search lifecycle recovery endpoint with the retained exact permit
constraints: assembly and lease exactly match the retained permit
correct replay preserves its original code
deadline without correct replay becomes COMMIT_FAILED
result must enter the ordinary terminal CAS

outputs.meaning: Непрозрачный recovery token с exact live permit и mismatch event для runtime supervisor
outputs.identity: recovery_token_id + permit_id + response_assembly_id + lease_id + conflicting termination identity + deadline
outputs.cardinality: exactly 1 per correlation failure
outputs.creation_condition: Mismatch is rejected before terminal CAS while permit remains OPEN
constraints: token contains the permit instead of relying on hidden process memory
token is usable only for the same response assembly
token expires only after terminal readback or owner-process cleanup

outputs.meaning: Закрытая попытка terminal, где normal response и все post-permit termination являются равноправными кандидатами одного outbox CAS
outputs.identity: workspace identity + permit_id + response_assembly_id + lease_id + NORMAL_RESPONSE(immutable envelope bytes + digest) | TIMEOUT | RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE | SEARCH_FAILED | CANCELLED | COMMIT_FAILED + source + stage + cause
outputs.cardinality: one or more racing attempts may exist per OPEN permit; exactly one can commit
outputs.creation_condition: Normal serialization becomes ready or one exact-correlated original, pending-acquired or recovered termination arrives
constraints: normal response and terminations share one arbitration surface
recovery is eligible only while its recovery token belongs to the same durable OPEN row
